text: APPROVE. The pin check, the bench stage and the cached base-arm lookup are moved into helpers with the same conditions, order, messages and cache writes, so complexity drops well below 15 and behaviour looks unchanged. I couldn't build it or see the unchanged middle of the method. The one risk to confirm is that the lone `<param>` tag on `CheckBenchAsync` could raise CS1573 if documentation generation is on with warnings as errors.
